name: Unlearn

brand.tagline: Most of what kids want to learn, you can't teach them. A coaching companion for curiosity-led learning, run on Ultrastable, the foundation for any autonomous system.

idea: A coaching companion for the adults around a curious child: log what the child is curious about, get a coaching move (a question back, something to try, a person or place, a reason to wait) instead of a lesson, and let the system follow up at 7 and 14 days and re-weight its moves by whether the child kept going on their own.
goals: Answer every logged curiosity with a coaching move and follow it up at 7 and 14 days
Raise self-directed continuation after 14 days to 0.5, measured and published weekly
Bring the telling-versus-asking ratio of coach notes below 0.3
positioning: Unlearn is the coach's side of Agora-style learning: coaches nurture, challenge, encourage and guide, and have to unlearn their training as teachers. No curriculum, no grades, no streaks.
